card.name: Upper end of confidence intervals
card.fires_on: The first digit (or decimal point) of the upper bound in a 95% confidence interval, after the lower bound and a comma or dash. It appears in risk ratio and hazard ratio results compared with placebo.

modes.description: The digit 1 that begins a two- or three-digit upper limit after the comma.
